The '''bachani''' was a species of flowering plant that the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] intended to introduce to [[Telos IV]] in the [[Telosian Restoration Project]]. It had tall stalks, wide leaves, and purple blossoms. Bachani extract had medicinal properties that made the import and export of the plant within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] restricted. The illegal sale of bachani extract was a lucrative business amongst the criminal underworld.
